I pay my rent using the credit card whenever i get a new one to meet the spending requirements.
Lots of people just meet it with regular expenses.

I do it with business expenses. I can often max out the spend requirement with one charge, but I’m not typical. My best so far is a $1000 bonus for $10k spend on Amex Simply cash – met in one phone call to a supplier.

Other people travel for business using their own cards then submit receipts for reimbursement to their employer.

Some people have insane monthly rent and use RadPad or Plastiq or something similar to pay their rent for a 2 – 3% fee.

A lot of people focus on one card at a time and put all their regular spending – insurance, groceries, gas, utilities, etc on that card until the minimum is met, then they get another card and switch to using it.

There’s more than one way to skin a cat. 🙂
